kind: perspective-correct surface CPU and memory correctness cost diagnostic
methodology: Identical release probes/locks and separate baseline/candidate target directories. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice, four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case; separate allocator-enabled builds. No agent-owned builds/checks ran during measurement. CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID is actual aggregate process CPU time. Warm scene render includes frame allocations, clipping, projection, shading and transparent sorting/scratch; excludes input/geometry construction, retained preparation, output validation and destruction. Geometry_builds must remain one. Within each version every frame must exactly match its own warm output, and a background-only image is rejected. Cross-version images are intentionally not equivalent: baseline uses incorrect triangle-average scalars and a single vertex normal; candidate uses per-fragment perspective interpolation. Independent f64 ray oracle establishes the new semantics, not these timing checks. Grids 8/24/48 cubed points at 128 square pixels; 24 cubed at 512 square, clipped 24 cubed at 128 square; two-triangle planes at 128/512 square. Flat color, viridis scalar gradients and half-opacity gradient variants. 21 cases total. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal state. CPU is not energy. Cumulative allocations are not peak/live/RSS; transparent scratch has a checked frame-budget/growth-peak limit but aggregate geometry and scene-order metadata remain outside it. GPU tests qualify a narrow fragment corpus on Metal, not portable/device-wide or mobile acceptance.
